reviews.title: Sliding curtains
reviews.text:
2026 marks the 50th year I am alive. I have encountered a handful of gifted clairvoyant readings. 
Palms read
Tarot cards and smudges to open my 3rd eye

I believe, I do have hidden gifts 
Such as seeing spirits or feeling their presence 

I’m interested in tapping on my gift

The guides here inspires me to pursue honing my gift.
reviews.reply: Hi there, Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re honored to hear that turning 50 and reflecting on your journey has inspired you to explore your hidden gifts more deeply. It’s wonderful that clairvoyant readings, palmistry, tarot, and practices like smudging have guided you toward opening your third eye and recognizing your ability to sense or see spirits. We’re glad our guides have encouraged you to pursue honing these gifts further. If you’d like to share more about which practices or tools resonate most with you, or suggest ways we can support your journey, please reach out at support-appstore@asknebula.com — your insights help us continue to improve and inspire. Best regards, Nebula Team🔮
